children: The metals trading industry is enjoying a boom for a second consecutive year, with traders earning billions and several leading firms posting record profits. According to Sina Finance, Trafigura Group recorded about $2 billion in metals-trading profit in its fiscal year through September, a record, while Glencore achieved one of its best-ever profit levels. Copper, gold and silver prices rose to record highs, and many traders received the highest compensation of their careers as well as job offers from multiple competitors.

title: Metal Traders Reap Billions as Trafigura Posts Record $2 Billion Profit
